name: Sarah Jenkins
title: Lead Product Designer & Design Engineer
summary: Creative Product Designer and Design Technologist with 7+ years of experience bridging the gap between design systems, UX research, and production frontend code. Passionate about crafting accessible, high-conversion digital experiences that delight millions of users globally.

experience.title: Lead Product Designer
experience.description:
Spearheaded the unified multi-platform design system used by 45+ product teams across web, iOS, and Android.
Conducted 60+ user testing sessions, redesigning core checkout flows resulting in a 22% increase in checkout conversions.
Mentored 6 junior and mid-level designers and led weekly cross-functional design crits with engineering leads.

experience.title: Senior UX/UI Designer
experience.description:
Designed mobile rider and driver apps from concept to launch, achieving a 4.9 App Store rating across 100k+ reviews.
Built interactive, high-fidelity prototypes using Figma, Framer, and React to accelerate stakeholder approvals.
